intro.title: Get a clear view of projects and workflows
intro.paragraph: Leaders in business and government are under increasing pressure to be more efficient and transparent. Innovative leaders use location intelligence to monitor, manage, and analyze key performance indicators. This real-time view of how assets and operations are performing helps identify inefficiencies and makes it easier to share data.

band.title: Get a clear view of projects and workflows
band.body: Fuse smart maps, analytics, and dashboards to see performance as it happens across people, services, assets, and events.

opportunities.title: See operational results others can’t
opportunities.intro: A shared map view of performance, empowered by real-time analytics, leads to greater efficiency and collaborative problem solving.
bullets: Harness smart maps, analytics, and dashboards for a real-time view of operations, people, services, assets, and events.
Identify areas of improvement by viewing key performance indicators in context of location
Collaborate and share data effectively and securely via maps, apps, and dashboards.
Strengthen quality control in business processes.
Improve response time to problems and issues.

capabilities.title: Capabilities
capabilities.blurb: Enable real-time performance monitoring using location intelligence technology from the Esri Geospatial Cloud.

items.title: Real-Time Visualization and Analytics
items.body: Know where vulnerabilities exist right now across your business and monitor changing situations. Use big data and Internet of Things (IoT) technology to make quick, informed decisions based on the most up-to-date information.

items.title: Spatial Analysis and Data Science
items.body: Use location as the connective thread to uncover hidden patterns and trends. Create a competitive edge by integrating location into machine learning models and artificial intelligence.

items.title: Mapping
items.body: Visualize people, places, and assets to gain a clear understanding of performance. See what's happening throughout the organization, create robust risk mitigation plans, and know where to allocate resources.

items.title: Asset Tracking and Analysis
items.body: Visualize moving and fixed assets dynamically. Implement problem-solving tools to accurately record the locations and health of your assets.

items.title: Risk Management
items.body: Know what risks are happening and where with smart maps. Find patterns and trends and communicate seamlessly during mitigation and response.

items.title: Operational Efficiency
items.body: Streamline projects and identify areas that need improvement. Rely on authoritative data to reduce errors and better allocate resources.

items.title: Big Data Keeps the Lights On
items.excerpt: The North American Grid must work together to keep the lights on throughout the United States and parts of Canada and Mexico.

items.title: LI Saves Geneva Airport Millions
items.excerpt: A small airport with big operations had to expand its operational efficiency to keep up with high demand.

items.title: Tracing Each Oyster from Tide to Table
items.excerpt: Taylor Shellfish Farms improved the resilience of the shellfish it raised. This required complete digital transformation and adaptability.
